🚨 Severe Weather Warning 🚨

Northeast Montana can expect dangerously cold temperatures tonight through Wednesday. Please exercise caution and stay safe out there, MT-02.

This week, I met with folks from the Montana Department of the American Legion and the Enlisted Association of the National Guard of Montana.

Had insightful conversations about mental health and suicide prevention. Thank you all for bringing much needed attention to these important issues facing Montana’s veterans.

Thank you to President George Richards and the @MTProFF for meeting with me to talk about the work you’re doing to keep our communities safe and better address the mental health of our first responders. https://t.co/bCaYmzITOd

I met with Emily Platt and John Hagengruber from the National Forest Service to get an update on the issues facing Lewis and Clark National Forest.

Thank you both for all you do to ensure the health of Montana’s public lands. https://t.co/24VwuvR5HD

A pleasure meeting with Vice-Chairman of the Chippewa Cree Tribal Council, Ted Russette III, and Joel Rosette, CEO of the Rocky Boy Health Center yesterday. 

We had a great conversation about tribal healthcare and how I can best represent the Chippewa Cree in Washington. https://t.co/lNxmDZmDIr

The @OfficialYBGR serves thousands of youths each year, providing full spectrum mental health services and transforming countless lives.

Our children are our future, and I appreciated the update on the ways I can assist you in your mission. https://t.co/xFTcccsYZ6

Access to comprehensive healthcare services is vital to our rural communities in Montana.

Today, I sat down with leadership from a number of hospitals across the Treasure State to talk about the challenges facing rural providers and proposals to ensure Montanans receive the best care available.

RiverStone Health in Billings is providing quality care that improves life, health, and safety outcomes. 

Thank you for a great discussion, tour of your facility, and the work you do to promote community wellbeing. https://t.co/2ILqT5riDz

Benefis Teton Medical Center provides an array of health services from radiology to primary care to Hospice.

Enjoyed learning more about your mission and the ways I can help the center carry it out. https://t.co/sDlIMHB4EC

Through my time on the Montana Land Board, I became acutely aware of the importance of proper land management to the health and longevity of our forests.

📺 Watch more from today's @NatResources hearing on the Fix our Forests Act 👇 https://t.co/2GDdcCpDSi

Today, my staff attended the groundbreaking of Intermountain Health's Montana Consolidated Services Center.

This new facility is critical to streamlining healthcare access for my constituents. Thanks to @Intermountain for your investment in MT-02. https://t.co/biwEE1AqDh

Honored to address Hometown Helena this morning!

Discussed Medicaid, tax cuts, and my Expanding Access to Capital for Rural Job Creators Act. https://t.co/SuUFqmHjhk

Great to meet with @NeighborWorksGF yesterday! 

As a member of @FinancialCmte’s Housing & Insurance Subcommittee, I’m committed to making housing more accessible and affordable for Montanans. We’ll keep fighting to strengthen communities across the state. https://t.co/EtOK1NB6ER

Had an amazing visit to @WeAreTouro’s Great Falls campus today! 

We discussed the critical need for expanding access to health care in our rural communities. Training the next generation of doctors is key to ensuring every Montanan has quality care close to home. https://t.co/wIBzxaTBwV

TRIA ensures coverage for acts of terrorism remains available and affordable in the wake of 9/11.

The program is overseen by the vestigial Federal Insurance Office, the existence of which violates the McCarran-Ferguson Act.

As our @FinancialCmte witnesses attest, eliminating FIO would have no effect on this critical program.

📺👇

Extraordinarily pleased to see additional personnel sent to the Crow Service Unit so that my constituents have the resources to improve health outcomes.

Thanks to @HHSGov for recognizing the needs of Montana’s tribal communities 🤝
https://t.co/R51eBXCDGy

I toured Intermountain Residential in Helena to see firsthand the critical support they provide for children and families across Montana.

For 116 years, this facility has offered care and resources to help children facing behavioral health challenges. That’s quite the legacy! https://t.co/CWiDt1VjFa

Joined a stacked panel to talk insurance in the Treasure State and beyond. Thanks to @BrownCSIMT and @idahodoi Director Dean Cameron for sharing the stage.

I’m taking my experience as State Auditor to Washington to pass bills like my FIO Elimination Act, reaffirming that regulation of the insurance industry rests with the states, not big government.

Stopped by the @MT_Realtors Fall Convention in Butte, America!

Addressed the room and shared an update on my work on @FinancialCmte's Housing and Insurance Subcommittee that’s impacting Montana’s realtors. https://t.co/uQ6fONPFXz

Democrats want to shut down the government over healthcare for illegal aliens and DEI initiatives in foreign countries.

Republicans want to keep the government open to pay our troops and serve our seniors and veterans without delays.

The difference could not be clearer.

ICYMI: My office was able to secure $2.3 MILLION from the IRS for Shodair Children’s Hospital to continue its good work providing pediatric healthcare services to Montana’s next generation.

🗞️ Learn more 👇
https://t.co/UBBA3nJq1a

For the rural and underserved communities that I represent in central and eastern Montana, investments in healthcare access just mean more.

If Democrats were allowed to follow through with their radical shutdown threats, they would rob America of $50 BILLION in funding for rural healthcare.

Do you want your tax dollars being used to pay for the health care for illegal aliens? 

House and Senate Democrats are digging in their heels and pushing to use YOUR TAX DOLLARS to fund health care for illegal aliens at the expense of historic investments in rural health care.

Yesterday, I had the privilege of attending the ribbon cutting of the new @montanastate Mark & Robyn Jones College of Nursing in Great Falls! 

This is the first completed project in MSU’s statewide expansion to strengthen nursing education and health care access for Montanans for generations to come.

It’s a sad day in America when getting our troops paid becomes a partisan exercise, but that’s where the left is headed these days.

Proud to join my @RepublicanStudy colleagues calling out @SenSchumer’s buffoonery. 

Open the government. Pay our troops.
